amendments.trigger: run 1 (code 6dd5b6a) aborted at the first mode-chan run: 'Attribute name=BearingAngle could not be set for this object: tid=ns3::UniformPlanarArray'. Only R0 had been evaluated (PASS); no other check result was produced
amendments.diagnosis: UniformPlanarArray accepts BearingAngle only in [-pi, pi] (MakeDoubleChecker(-M_PI, M_PI), uniform-planar-array.cc); the program passed 270 deg = 4.71 rad. The smoke runs used 0, 45 and 90 deg only
changes: bearings are wrapped to [-180, 180) deg before they are set (270 deg -> -90 deg, the same orientation), in modes chan and nrfading
amendments.unchanged: every check, threshold, run and decision rule; the links files keep the E1.4 bearing values (30, 150, 270)

amendments.trigger: run 2 (code 58872cc): R0, A0, N0, B0.0-B0.3 PASS; V0 FAILED in all 9 nrfading runs (max |error| 35-67 dB)
amendments.diagnosis: scripts/e1_5_2_0_run2_v0_diagnostic.py, output in run2_V0_diagnostic.txt: the 217 DL TBs that span the full band and are alone in their slot match the channel-level gain within 3.2e-14 dB; the 4,282 others are OFDMA TBs co-scheduled in the same symbols on partial bands (errors -53.7 to +13.2 dB, 1st-99th percentile), many decoded at MCS 28 although their reported SINR is ~50 dB below the full-band value. V0 compares each TB with the full-band gain of the UE's own beam, which presumes one UE per transmission over the full band. Under NrMacSchedulerOfdmaRR with DirectPath beams (every UE has the empty beam ID, so the scheduler treats all UEs as one beam), that premise does not hold
amendments.defect: instrument (V0's premise not met by the OFDMA DL scheduler), not the channel-level computation
changes: nrfading runs use ns3::NrMacSchedulerTdmaRR (DL TDMA: every TB spans the full band and one UE per symbol group; its DL round robin rotates, E1.5.1 / E1.5.1-D)
amendments.unchanged: V0's criterion and tolerance (every DL TB within 0.01 dB), every other check, run and threshold
amendments.prediction_before_run_3: every DL TB spans 51 RBs and V0 passes in all 9 nrfading runs; R0, A0, N0 and B0 reproduce run 2 (same seeds)
amendments.open_item: the meaning of the reported SINR of OFDMA TBs co-scheduled under DirectPath beams (all UEs share the empty beam ID) is diagnosed before any multi-UE stage (E1.5.4)

stack.program: ns3/scratch/cmwave/e15-link-validation.cc, modes chan and nrfading added; mode link (E1.5.1) unchanged and re-checked by R0

source_facts: ns-3 commit 80c131f7f (2026-02-12, issue #1314, in our ns-3 tree): the 3GPP long-term component is w_u^H H w_s, i.e. the receive-side weights are conjugated; H(u,s) of a ray carries exp(+j 2 pi r_A.d_u) exp(+j 2 pi r_D.d_s) (three-gpp-channel-model.cc)

NR CreateDirectPathBfv (beamforming-vector.cc) gives w = exp(-j 2 pi r.d) / sqrt(N) for BOTH the gNB and the UE (ideal-beamforming-algorithm.cc lines 381/387). It is matched (|w^T a|^2 = N) on the transmit side 's' and, by our reading, anti-matched on the receive side 'u'. NR fixed only its realistic beamforming for #1314 (NR 02da6eef, RELEASE_NOTES)
ns-3's own three-gpp-channel-example.cc uses sign -1 for the transmitter and +1 for the receiver
Which antenna is 's' is fixed when the channel matrix of a pair is first generated (ChannelMatrix::IsReverse); the reverse direction reuses the transposed long-term component

The large-scale parameters are assigned in canonical node-ID order (three-gpp-channel-model.cc GetChannel): the lower node ID gets the departure (BS-side) statistics. The gNB is node 0 in modes chan and nrfading
ThreeGppAntennaModel 'Outdoor' = TR 38.901 Table 7.3-1 element (8 dBi, 65/65 deg, SLA_V = A_max = 30 dB), identical to E1.4
geometry: configs/e1/positions_munich_tx0.json: gNB (8.5, 21.0, 27.0), the 27 UE positions at 1.5 m; LOS/NLOS = geometric_class (E1.1); all links O2O in E1.5.2-0
serving_sector: E1.4 rule: cmwave.radio.antenna.gnb_gain_dbi (largest element gain; bearings 30/150/270 deg)
large_scale_loss: E1.2 median path loss per link and carrier (nrfading only; mode chan applies no path loss)
channel: TR 38.901 UMa fast fading (ns-3 ThreeGppChannelModel, ThreeGppSpectrumPropagationLossModel), condition prescribed per link, 20 MHz, 30 kHz, 51 RBs, no blockage, UpdatePeriod 0
ue_antenna: 1x1 isotropic (E1.5.2-0 and E1.5.2-1 test the gNB term only)
rng: ns-3 defaults (RngSeed 1, RngRun 1); spectrum model streams from 1000

nrfading_runs.per_config: one run per sector bearing (30, 150, 270 deg) with the UEs that sector serves

settings.other: E1.5.1 common settings (44 dBm, NF 5/7 dB, RbOverhead 0.073, numerology 1, DDDSU); no UL traffic

checks.R0_link_mode_unchanged: mode link rerun of E1.5.1 f3p5_ofdma: all 8 output files byte-identical (SHA-256) to E1.5.1 run 4
checks.A0_conventions: every link, regimes A (8x16) and B (16x32): ns-3 angles equal the Python link_angles within 1e-6 deg; ns-3 transmit-side array factor of the NR DirectPath vector toward the geometric direction equals 10 log10(N) within 1e-6 dB; element gain + array factor equals the E1.4 gNB gain (gnb_gain_dbi, serving sector) within 0.01 dB
checks.N0_normalisation: isotropic gNB and UE: |10 log10(mean linear gain over all realizations)| <= 0.25 dB, separately for LOS and NLOS links, at each carrier
checks.B0_0_roles: every chan realization reports the gNB in the requested role (gnb_is_s = 1 for role s, 0 for role u)
checks.B0_1_matched_s: role s, NR DirectPath: median over LOS links of D = G_E1.4 - G_real <= 2 dB, at each carrier
checks.B0_2_matched_u: role u, conjugated NR DirectPath: median over LOS links of D <= 2 dB, at each carrier
checks.B0_3_antimatched_u: role u, NR DirectPath: median over LOS links of G_real(s, dp) - G_real(u, dp) >= 3 dB, at each carrier
checks.V0_nr_identity: every nrfading run: every DL TB has |10 log10(m_sinr) - (SNR_iso + 10 log10 g_direct)| <= 0.01 dB, with SNR_iso the E1.5.1-verified Python DL SNR and g_direct recomputed after the run on the same channel objects; the gNB is 's' for every link; every UE has >= 10 distinct DL TBs; channel-model frequency read back equals the carrier
checks.definitions: G_real(link) = 10 log10 of the mean over the copies of the linear gain; D uses the E1.4 gNB gain of the serving sector; TBs counted by key (erratum 1)

reported_not_tested: per link: D for NLOS links; (s, dpconj); the deterministic receive-side array factor af_u of the NR DirectPath vector; realised gain of regime B

decision_rules.instrument_valid: R0, A0, N0 and V0 pass -> mode chan reproduces 5G-LENA's DL SINR and its antenna conventions equal E1.4's; E1.5.2-1 may use mode chan for many realizations, with nrfading spot checks
decision_rules.rx_side_mismatch_established: B0_1-B0_3 hold at both carriers -> an array on the receive side 'u' of the stored channel matrix needs the conjugated DirectPath vector. Every later configuration states which side each array is on; UE arrays (E1.5.2b) use a matched combiner; the finding is written up for the 5G-LENA maintainers (filing is the user's decision)
decision_rules.reading_wrong: B0_3 fails -> the code reading was wrong; recorded; no compensation is used
decision_rules.stop: R0, A0, N0 or V0 fails -> stop and diagnose before E1.5.2-1
decision_rules.no_rerun: a failed check is not re-run with a changed threshold
